statement: Largest known training run >= 5e27 FLOP (Epoch AI; by 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met; largest known run ~5e25 FLOP at mid-2024 (Epoch estimate for the largest disclosed model), ~100x below 5e27. Epoch measured frontier compute growth of 4-5x/year (May) and judged ~2e29 FLOP runs feasible by 2030 (Aug); at 4-5x/year, 5e25 reaches 5e27 in ~3 years (around 2027), so the indicator was live at end-2024. The largest open-weight model released in 2024 (405B dense) was described by its developer as comparable to leading models; its paper reports compute in the mid-1e25 range (body not re-read this run).

items.summary: Epoch AI estimated training compute of frontier models grows 4-5x per year (4x/year at the frontier since 2018); the largest models with estimates were ~2e25 FLOP and ~5e25 FLOP.
items.detail: Epoch AI, 'Training compute of frontier AI models grows by 4-5x per year' (GPT-4 ~2e25, Gemini Ultra ~5e25 FLOP). Publication date from memory (May 2024); page content verified this run.

items.summary: A top-5 developer published the technical report of its largest open-weight model (405B dense parameters), claiming quality comparable to leading models. Its training compute (mid-1e25 FLOP per the report body, not re-read here) is consistent with the end-2024 frontier being well below 1e26.
items.detail: Meta, 'The Llama 3 Herd of Models', arXiv:2407.21783 v1 2024-07-31 (Llama 3.1 405B; report states ~3.8e25 FLOP - figure not re-verified this run).

items.summary: Epoch AI judged training runs of ~2e29 FLOP likely technically feasible by 2030, with power as the first binding constraint; planned 1-5 GW campuses would support 1e28-3e29 FLOP runs. Implies 5e27 by 2027 is feasible if the 4x/year trend holds.
items.detail: Epoch AI, 'Can AI scaling continue through 2030?' (Aug 2024; publication day from memory).
